page.layout: One printed page, single column. Top: running text, continuing from the previous page. Below a gap: an italic prayer in four paragraphs, the last running over the foot. Bottom: signature at left, catchword at right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: gis inter Subditos esse decuerat) plena pote-statis.

Vis maxime Divina Ratio est: nunquam inopem Me virium putabo, dum hac integrē & liberē frui liceat. Nulla externa Fortunæ Eclipsis hac Me luce innatā fraudabit. Quicquid extra Deus negabit roboris, intus à Gratia Illius (uti spero) in constanti animo suppleb-itur, non ut negem præfractè quod concedi par est, sed ne quid ejusmodi concedam quod Ratio & Religio jubent negare.
Nec Me interim minorem factum existimabo, dum hanc Conscientiæ integritatem custodiam quæ Mihi sola Gemma supereft digna servari.

p.i: O Tu Animarum Moderator Supreme, qui Conscientiis nostris solus imperas: licet ignorem quid agere debeam, oculos meos ad Te dirigo. In tutelam tuæ Misericordiæ me semper committo.
Quemadmodum Me servasti in die prælii, ita & adhuc potes vim Tuam in infirmitate mea ostendere.

main_text.p: Sis Tu mihi in nocte obscurissima Columna Ignis quâ illuminari simul possim & dirigi, & in die Tribulationis ferventissima sis Columna nubis Me inumbrans & protegens.

p.i: Tu nosti (Domine) Me nulla penitus animi pervicacia sed justissimis argumentis persuasum, a Ratione, Honore, Religione dutis hæc &

page.notes: Printed "Eclipsis" with long s, given as Eclipsis. "dutis" is uncertain and may be read as "debitis"; left as printed in appearance but unverified. Italic/roman distinction in the prayer (e.g. "Columna", "Ignis") is inferred from the scan and may be imperfect. The paragraph at the foot continues onto the next page. Fragment "gis" at the top is a line-start fragment and stays as is. Show-through and edge marks on the left and right margins are omitted.
